$schema-note: v3.2.0 (3P Matrix alignment §5) — a register of every external data source this project's build-time tooling ingests, in one place. Read by tools/check-list-freshness.mjs; maintained by hand alongside the update script each entry names (adding a new source: add it here too). 'updateOn' (v3.3.0, item 19) is an optional cadence label distinct from the generic 'updateFrequencyNote' prose: 'minor' means this project intends to re-fetch it once per minor release (a list that changes slowly enough that the generic ~180-day staleness warning would otherwise under-prompt a refresh); omitted means the default 'per release' cadence applies.

sources.name: Public Suffix List — PRIVATE section (hosting-platform suffixes)
sources.updateFrequencyNote: v3.3.0 (3P Matrix alignment item 1) — util/DomainAge.js's platform-subdomain skip list. Shares its raw cached file with the 'Public Suffix List' entry above (refreshed by tools/update-psl.mjs --fetch); this entry's own updateScript only re-extracts the PRIVATE DOMAINS section into its own JSON, it does not re-fetch. New hosting platforms are added to the PSL at most a few times a month — refreshing once per minor release is ample.

sources.name: IANA RDAP bootstrap registry (ccTLDs with RDAP service)
sources.license: n/a — IANA public registry data, not a licensed redistribution
sources.updateFrequencyNote: v3.3.0 (3P Matrix alignment item 1) — util/DomainAge.js's not-applicable ccTLD list (RdapProtection.js skips the lookup for a ccTLD not in this list, rather than attempting it and scoring the inevitable failure). A registry adopting RDAP is a rare, deliberate event — minor-release cadence is ample; this is not something that needs the 180-day generic staleness warning to catch early.
